subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for Control UI structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it into the open reply-runtime and final-fallback canonicals before implementation continues?
rationale: Current main is partial and the remaining work defines protocol/runtime/session and final-delivery semantics rather than a single mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and let the durable final fallback issue own no-output delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after confirming the Control UI reply metadata and no-output portions are fully tracked by specific open canonical issues or PRs.

options.title: Accept Markdown Reply As Enough
options.body: Treat the current webchat Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI replies and leave only the fallback-delivery work elsewhere, accepting that exact reply identity is not structured.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and let the durable final fallback issue own no-output delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is a recent contributor on the runtime-context prompt boundary where the reply contract would land, and the decision crosses product/API boundaries rather than a single file repair.
